title: Write your next 300K manuscript with AI for just $37
excerpt: Write it, own it, and publish it however you choose.
content_html:
TL;DR: Write a 300K-word manuscript for just $37 with this YouBooks AI lifetime subscription.

Credit: Youbooks

$36.75
$540 Save $503.25

Writing is just one step in creating a book. Before that comes research, outlining, drafting, and editing. But for only $36.75 (reg. $540), you’ll be able to craft publish-ready 300,000-word manuscripts for life through Aug. 9 with code AUG25. Even the busiest educators, content creators, entrepreneurs, and coaches can get their words out as intended.

The platform is powered by various leading AI platforms, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Llama, to help you generate cohesive, expertly crafted, and engaging content. With it, you can use the monthly 250K credits your lifetime subscription provides for source uploads or writing.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

One credit accounts for one word or one uploaded source word; you also have the option to store up to 100 writing style samples and 100 source documents for easy access. What’s more, YouBooks pulls full real-time web searches during the writing composition, so you can rest assured that any facts, stats, and news you use are current, up-to-date, and accurate.

Mashable Trend Report

The source uploads don’t have to be from the web either. You can guide the AI or even upload your own memos, transcripts, and documents to foreground your work. Plus, you can also define and curate your own writing style to ensure consistency and a cohesive end project.

As you can see, each book goes through a series of steps to move from ideation to completion. Better yet, you get to retain full ownership of your content—meaning you can look forward to publishing, distributing, or even selling it without restriction.

Whether you’re writing a memoir, educational guide, teaching resource, or simply consolidating your work, YouBooks can assist you at every stage. So, why not try it out?

Get your YouBooks AI Lifetime Subscription for just $36.75 (reg. $540) with code AUG25, only through August 9. 

StackSocial prices subject to change.

TL;DR：通过 YouBooks AI 终身订阅，仅需 37 美元即可撰写 30 万字的手稿。

信用：Youbooks

$36.75
$540 Save $503.25

写作只是创作一本书的一个步骤。 在此之前是研究、提纲、起草和编辑。 但只需 36.75 美元（原价 540 美元），您就可以在 8 月 9 日之前使用代码 AUG25 制作可供出版的 300,000 字手稿。 即使是最忙碌的教育工作者、内容创作者、企业家和教练也可以按预期表达自己的意思。

该平台由各种领先的人工智能平台（例如 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Llama）提供支持，可帮助您生成有凝聚力、精心制作且引人入胜的内容。 有了它，您可以使用终身订阅提供的每月 250K 积分来上传或写作源代码。

混搭优惠

注册即表示您同意按照提供的号码接收来自 Mashable Deals 的定期自动 SMS 营销消息。 消息和数据速率可能适用。 每天最多 2 条消息。 回复 STOP 可选择退出，回复 HELP 寻求帮助。 同意不是购买的条件。 请参阅我们的隐私政策和使用条款。

1个积分相当于1个词或1个上传的源词；您还可以选择存储最多 100 个写作风格样本和 100 个源文档以便于访问。 此外，YouBooks 在写作过程中会进行完整的实时网络搜索，因此您可以放心，您使用的任何事实、统计数据和新闻都是最新的、最新的和准确的。

可混搭趋势报告

源上传也不必来自网络。 您可以指导人工智能，甚至可以上传您自己的备忘录、成绩单和文档来展示您的工作。 另外，您还可以定义和策划自己的写作风格，以确保一致性和有凝聚力的最终项目。

正如您所看到的，每本书都经历了一系列从构思到完成的步骤。 更好的是，您可以保留对内容的完全所有权，这意味着您可以不受限制地发布、分发甚至出售内容。

无论您是在撰写回忆录、教育指南、教学资源，还是只是巩固您的工作，YouBooks 都可以在每个阶段为您提供帮助。 那么，为什么不尝试一下呢？

使用优惠码 AUG25 即可获得 YouBooks AI 终身订阅，仅需 36.75 美元（原价 540 美元），有效期仅限 8 月 9 日。
